complaint: Porch camera offline. It said low battery a few days ago, so maybe that's all it is. I don't have much time to deal with this, so please just tell me what to do or send me whatever part I need and I'll swap it myself this weekend.
usability_reason: The response is polite and gives a clear next step (engineering review within 1-2 business days), but it is largely non-actionable for a customer who explicitly asked what to do or which part to swap. It also asserts a power-on/disconnect log event (07:15/07:16) that the customer never confirmed—they explicitly said they had not checked whether it stays on after unplugging—so it claims a diagnostic finding not supported by the session record. The root-cause label is plausible but not demonstrated, and the customer's request for a self-swap part is not addressed.
